NFL DFS Quarterback Rankings: Week 5 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 11 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 10, 12:34 PM ET

Jared Goff is the top-projected quarterback on the Week 5 DraftKings main slate at 20.6 DraftKings points for $6,600, at Arizona. Drake Maye (20.4, $6,300) and Jayden Daniels (18.8, $6,000) are next.

Tyson Bagent returns the most per dollar among quarterbacks projected for at least 15 points: 3.88 projected points per $1,000 at $4,700.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 10, 12:34 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Quarterbacks to know in Week 5

Jared Goff, DET at ARI ($6,600)

Jared Goff carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 20.6 DraftKings points at $6,600, the 3rd-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.2 points clear of Drake Maye. The salary works out to 3.12 projected points per $1,000, 11th of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Goff averaged 20.6 points with a simulated floor of 8.3 and a ceiling of 37.6, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 5.5-point favorite on the road against Arizona, with an implied team total of 30 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Drake Maye, NE vs LV ($6,300)

Drake Maye projects 2nd at the position with 20.4 DraftKings points at $6,300, 5th on the main slate overall. The model includes 5.0 rushing attempts. The salary works out to 3.24 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Maye averaged 20.5 points with a simulated floor of 8.2 and a ceiling of 37.2, and he holds 8% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New England is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Las Vegas, with an implied team total of 24.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Value: Tyson Bagent, CHI at GB ($4,700)

Tyson Bagent projects for 18.3 DraftKings points at $4,700, which works out to 3.88 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 20 quarterbacks the model projects for 15 or more points. The model includes 6.6 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Bagent averaged 18.2 points with a simulated floor of 6.8 and a ceiling of 33.4, and he holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Chicago is a 1.5-point favorite on the road against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 46.5.
